name: straddle human flag
description: A human flag with the legs straight and spread wide. The straddle makes the full flag lever a little shorter.
instructions: Take your flag grip and kick up into a vertical or tuck flag.
Extend both legs out into a wide straddle.
Hold your body sideways and level with the floor.
Keep both arms locked and your shoulders pushed away from your ears.
Hold, then bring your legs together and lower with control.
